Hi Sanjay / Priya,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — good to learn more about Acme's search and personalization roadmap. Per our call, I wanted to recap next steps and a couple quick asks that will help us put together a timeline and a light mutual action plan.

Key takeaways from today's call:
- Primary use case: realtime product search & content re-ranking across web and mobile.
- Traffic profile: 150M monthly searches, 99th percentile latency target ~150ms.
- Success criteria: 90% of queries within SLA, 20% reduction in per-query inference cost vs current baseline.

As discussed, could you share a quick stakeholder map so we can align on the approval path? Specifically:
1) Economic buyer / budget owner for infrastructure and platform purchases
2) Security / privacy / legal contacts who will own the vendor security questionnaire (SOC 2, data residency, encryption)
3) Procurement contact and any required procurement timelines or PO processes
4) Any product/engineering SMEs we should include for an architecture review

If it's easier, an org chart PDF or a short email intro chain works — even just the names + titles.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll share a short follow-up with suggested architecture and a proposed pilot scope + timeline.
- We'll include procurement/contract checklist and a sample SOW template for your legal/procurement team.

Attachments: demo recording (link will follow), sample SOW template.

Would you be able to send the stakeholder map this week? If so, we can target an architecture review the week of Nov 30.

Thanks,
